internal_discovery.distinctiveness_note: Distinct from saying, promising, and covenanting because it specifically invokes oath force upon an assertion.
internal_discovery.rationale: The performative oath nucleus is explicit, stable, and distinctive in every occurrence.

rejection_condition.challenging_finding: Hlf: reject the current universal oath-binding account if a swearing verb or habitual swearer occurrence does not bind an assertion by invocation, or if truth, falsehood, or covenant content is required by the root act.
rejection_condition.search_location: Batch 06 Hlf: all 13 occurrence_dispositions across material clusters habitual_swearer, swearing_verbs.
rejection_condition.verification_method: Test 'binding one's assertion by an invoked oath' against every listed supporting_evidence_refs and counterevidence_refs entry, retaining any failed class boundary.
rejection_condition.confounder_control: Prepositions identify what is sworn by and clauses supply oath content; the intensive noun marks habitual frequency. None changes the oath act.
rejection_condition.failure_consequence: Hlf: restrict the result to the compatible oath act and keep assertion truth and moral assessment in the content/context layer.

reopen_conditions: Hlf: reopen when a false-oath occurrence such as 58:18 is shown to lack an invoked assertion-binding act.
Hlf: reopen when a canonical syntactic correction alters what is sworn or the agent of a decisive oath occurrence.

falsification_evidence.status_rationale: The persisted adversarial record is SUPPORTed, falsifiable, and distinctive.
